overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Moringa Leaf Powder in bulk for B2B buyers who need a steady, consistent ingredient source. We are an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India. Our powder is made from carefully selected leaves and processed under controlled conditions for dependable quality, fine texture, and export-ready supply.

Our process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch. The powder is available in 80–100 mesh with moisture below 8.0% and a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture. OEM and private label support is available, along with samples on request.
highlights: Dehydrated by shade or low-temperature drying
